Overall, individuals representing 92 NOCs received at least one medal, with 64 of them winning at least one gold medal. Botswana, Dominica, Guatemala, and Saint Lucia won their nations' first Olympic gold medals. Albania, Cape Verde, Dominica, and Saint Lucia won their nations' first Olympic medals. The Refugee Olympic Team also won their first medal. [...] The United States led the final medal table for the fourth consecutive Summer Games, with 40 gold and 126 total medals, while China finished second with 40 gold and 91 medals in total. The occasion marked the first time a gold medal tie among the two most successful nations has occurred in Summer Olympics history. # See the current Olympic medal count for the 2024 Paris Games

Updated on: August 11, 2024 / 8:03 PM EDT
/ CBS News

[Team USA](https://www.cbsnews.com/news/team-usa-paris-olympics-2024/) topped the medals table at the [Paris Olympic Games](https://www.cbsnews.com/feature/2024-olympics-summer-paris/) with 40 gold medals and a total of 126.

China, who were the last team apart from the U.S. to top the medal table when they did it at home at the 2008 Beijing Games, also won 40 golds. But because they managed only 27 silvers, they finished second on the medals table. The U.S. earned 44 silver medals.

The U.S. women's basketball team secured Team USA's final gold medal by [edging host nation France in a thrilling match](https://www.cbsnews.com/news/us-womens-basketball-france-olympics-gold-medal/) that came down to the last shot.

The CBS News [medal count](https://www.cbssports.com/olympics/news/2024-paris-olympics-medal-count-tracker-for-how-many-gold-silver-bronze-medals-usa-each-country-has-won/) tracker below shows the final tally.

![Table showing the number of medals won by each country or delegation in the 2024 Summer Olympics in Paris](https://datawrapper.dwcdn.net/cQK4Y/full.png)

In addition to the medals, which are unique to each [Olympic](https://www.cbsnews.com/news/best-photos-2024-paris-olympic-games/) Games, some winners will get additional awards from their home nations. Cash prizes, cows or even apartments are some of the [rewards medal winners](https://www.cbsnews.com/news/2024-olympics-paris-athletes-medals-prize-money/) in some sports or from certain countries will enjoy. And while some athletes will [set world records in Paris](https://www.cbsnews.com/news/mondo-duplantis-pole-vaulting-record-olympic-gold-paris-2024/), those can be set at other international competitions. Olympic medals, however, are only earned at the Games.

## Which country had the most medals in the 2020 Olympics?

The [2020 Olympic Games](https://www.cbsnews.com/feature/2021-olympics-summer-tokyo/), held in Tokyo in 2021 after a COVID-related delay, were a much more sober affair than most Games due to to the coronavirus pandemic. There, the U.S. narrowly edged out China for most gold medals, 39 to 38, but remained comfortably ahead in overall medals, with American athletes taking home 113 medals to second-place China's 89.

## Which country had the most gold medals in the 2022 Olympics?

In the [2022 Winter Games, held in Beijing](https://www.cbsnews.com/feature/winter-olympics-2022-beijing/), the U.S. was third in both the gold-medal count and overall medals, with nine golds and 25 overall. Norway topped the count with 16 golds and 37 total medals, followed by Germany in both gold medals, with 12, and overall medals, with 27. Host nation China tied the U.S. in the number of gold medals, but trailed in the total medal count, with 15.

## Which country has the most medals overall?

According to the Olympic Foundation for Culture and Heritage, the U.S. leds the [all-time medal count](https://www.cbsnews.com/news/2024-paris-games-most-olympic-medals-ever/) going into the Paris Games with a total of 2,975 Olympic medals, followed by the now-defunct Soviet Union, with 1,204 medals, and Germany, with 1,058 medals.

And, as hoped, the [U.S. added to its medal haul](https://www.cbssports.com/olympics/news/2024-paris-olympics-updates-results-tracker-team-usa-schedule-united-states-medal-count-from-summer-games/live/) at the 2024 Games, [topping 3,000 total medals](https://www.cbsnews.com/news/usa-olympics-all-time-medal-count/) within the first week of competition. The American team is helped by the sheer [number of competitors](https://www.cbsnews.com/news/athletes-olympics-numbers-2024-paris-games/) representing Team USA at the Paris Games: 594 athletes, of the about 10,500 athletes competing. Four countries in this year's games have only one athlete taking a shot at medal glory: Belize, Liechtenstein, Nauru and Somalia.

And since Russia was banned for this year's games, any medals garnered by its few athletes competing as [individual neutral athletes](https://www.cbsnews.com/news/what-is-ain-olympics-russia-belarus/) won't be tallied as part of the country's overall haul. The first individual neutral athlete to medal in the Games was Viyaleta Bardzilouskaya of Belarus, who took silver in women's trampoline.

## Which country has the most gold medals overall?

The U.S. will also hope to keep its ranking as the nation with the most gold medals: a total of 1,179 ahead of the Paris Games, according to the Olympic Foundation. Following is the [Soviet Union](https://www.olympedia.org/countries/URS), with 473 gold medals. [Germany](https://www.olympedia.org/countries/GER) takes third, with 342 gold medals.

The U.S. notched its [first gold medal of the Games](https://www.cbsnews.com/news/team-usa-swimming-gold-silver-bronze-freestyle-paris-olympics-2024/) with a gold in the men's 4x100 freestyle relay. And, of course, [Simone Biles](https://www.cbsnews.com/news/simone-biles-suni-lee-paris-olympics-all-around-individual-gymnastics/) and the [U.S. women's gymnastics team](https://www.cbsnews.com/news/artistic-gymnastics-olympics-2024-team-final-simone-biles/) turned in dominant performances to bring home individual and team gold, and swimmers [Katie Ledecky](https://www.cbsnews.com/news/katie-ledecky-gold-medal-1500-meter-freestyle-record-womens-swimming-paris-olympics/) and Torri Huske each added to the tally.

Running phenom [Noah Lyles narrowly notched the gold](https://www.cbsnews.com/news/noah-lyles-wins-gold-photo-finish-100-meter-sprint-paris-olympics/) in a photo finish to the 100 meters, and [Cole Hocker](https://www.cbsnews.com/news/cole-hocker-upset-gold-medal-1500m-paris-olympics-2024/) pulled off a stunning upset to give the U.S. a gold in the 1500 meters, coming from behind to beat the two favorites in the field. [Quincy Hall also came from behind,](https://www.cbsnews.com/news/quincy-hall-usa-wins-gold-medal-paris-olympic-400-meters/) nabbing the U.S. first gold medal in the 400 meters since 2008.

# Team USA Paris 2024 Olympic Medals

Jul 26, 2024 – Aug 11, 2024

[Paralympic Medals](/paris-2024/paralympics/medals)

## Paris 2024 Olympic Games Medals

Team USA came out on top at the [Paris 2024](/paris-2024) Olympic Games, winning 126 total Olympic medals, with our athletes taking home 40 gold medals, 44 silver medals, and 42 bronze medals. China tied Team USA with 40 gold medals, but came up short in silver and bronze, leading to their second place finish with 91 total medals. In the previous Summer Olympic Games in [Tokyo 2020](https://www.teamusa.com/olympic-games-tokyo-2020), Team USA also finished first, winning 39 gold medals, 41 silver medals and 33 bronze medals, for a combined total of 113 Olympic medals.

[Track and field](https://www.usatf.org/) and [swimming](https://www.usaswimming.org/) were our most winning categories, with track and field events contributing 34 total medals (14 gold, 11 silver, 9 bronze), and swimming contributing 28 (8 gold, 13 silver, 7 bronze). Virginia native [Torri Huske](https://www.teamusa.com/profiles/torri-huske) won the most medals out of all of the Team USA athletes with 5 total medals including 3 gold and 2 silver. The other athletes that topped the charts include gymnast [Simone Biles](https://www.teamusa.com/profiles/simone-biles) and swimmers [Gretchen Walsh](https://www.teamusa.com/profiles/gretchen-walsh), [Katie Ledecky](https://www.teamusa.com/profiles/katie-ledecky-851377) and [Regan Smith](https://www.teamusa.com/profiles/regan-smith-1005704), all with 4 Olympic medals.

**Some of the top highlights from the 2024 Olympic games include:**

* U.S. men’s [water polo team won a bronze medal](https://www.teamusa.com/news/2024/august/11/us-mens-water-polo-win-bronze-over-hungary-the-first-medal-in-16-years), the first medal in 16 years
* The U.S. men’s basketball team claimed [fifth straight Olympic gold medal](https://www.teamusa.com/news/2024/august/11/5-peat-achieved-for-the-avengers-us-mens-basketball-claims-olympic-gold)
* U.S. women's basketball team won [eighth straight Olympic gold medal](https://www.teamusa.com/news/2024/august/11/us-womens-basketball-makes-it-eight-consecutive-olympic-golds)
* [Team USA’s indoor volleyball team won silver](https://www.teamusa.com/news/2024/august/11/us-womens-volleyball-extends-longest-olympic-medal-streak-with-silver-in-paris), making history with the longest medal streak for the sport in U.S. history, and record for most medals for the sport in any country
* Sydney McLaughlin-Levrone won gold and set a new world record in the [women's 400-meter hurdles final](https://www.teamusa.com/news/2024/august/13/top-moments-from-the-paris-2024-olympic-games)
* Our [artistic swimming team won a silver medal](https://www.teamusa.com/news/2024/august/08/artistic-swimming-team-takes-first-medal-in-20-years-a-silver), the first medal in 20 years
* U.S. women’s swimming team set a [new world record in the 4x100-meter medley relay](https://www.teamusa.com/news/2024/august/05/a-new-world-record-by-the-us-women-closes-out-swimming-in-paris), winning gold
